title: The Canaanite and the Prophet Zechariah
english: “You shall not bring a dog, even as a prostitute’s hire, into the house of the Lord your God.” (Malachi 1:7). For, this being guarded, there is no Canaanite in the house of the Lord of all, on the day that is dawned upon by the sun of righteousness, the light of the true, Only-begotten Son of God.
The end of the unseized goal of the prophet Zechariah, who is set forth for clarity, and we cease the arrangement of the notes regarding him.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Canaanite and the Light of Justice
english: “You shall not bring a dog or a prostitute's wages into the house of the Lord your God.” (Malachi 1:10). For by guarding this, no Canaanite remains in the house of the Lord Almighty on the day that is dawned upon by the sun of justice, the light of the true, Only-begotten Son of God. The unreached end of the prophet Zechariah, set forth for clarity, and we cease the arrangement of the commentaries regarding him.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Canaanite and the End of Zechariah
english: “You shall not bring a dog or a prostitute’s hire into the house of the Lord your God” (Malachi 2:17). For by guarding this, there is no Canaanite in the house of the Lord of all, on the day that is dawned upon by the sun of righteousness (Malachi 4:2), the light of the true, Only-begotten Son of God.
The end, unseized, of the prophet Zechariah being set forth for clarity, and we rest from the arrangement of the commentaries upon him.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
